cases.raw_input: We use one dual-memory policy. Store every qualifying durable memory in both Engram and the active tool's native memory when available. Engram is the canonical cross-tool copy. A qualifying memory must be durable, non-obvious, actionable, and likely to matter again. Qualifying memories include corrections, decisions, recurring pitfalls, stable preferences, environment constraints, and proven discoveries. Exclude transient progress, routine details, guesses, one-off failures, secrets, and facts already clear from code or docs. When a stored fact changes, correct both the Engram copy and the active tool's native memory copy. I copied three files and am waiting for CI.
